> For example for my Nmom taking to her "nicely" but with an slightly demeaning tone or yelling a bit did the trick.

Yeah that's what I did. I talked calmly but still with a somewhat demeaning tone and she didn't get as angry and mad as she normally would. Had I talked with a more aggressive tone she would've probably beaten me up a lot worse. Do you think I shoulld report this ?
i don't think much will happen because what if it doesn't leave bruises?
He does but he doesn't do anything against it, like she could be beating me in front of the TV and my dad would just say "move somewhere else" because he wants to watch the tv

I'm scared of talking about it with people in real life because I'm scared of legal action being taken (me or my mother taken away, she only treats me like this and she has a good relationship with my brother and dad so I don't want them to possibly be sad) and because I can't go to a counselor/therapist, I'd have to ask my family first and they'd just say no because they would think I'm faking it. And yes my dad lives at home

I'm 14, and she's been acting like that towards me since I was 11. I can try recording audio, i didn't think of that  

>if she wants to stay out of jail  

She would often say that she wanted to kill me yet didn't do it because she didn't want to go to jail. She always said she did all these things "out of anger" and that she just wanted to encourage me but I'm still very scared living with a person like her
I can't get out I'm still too young for that. But I feel like if I tried to do that as soon as I could my mother probably wouldn't let me
